btw.title: Read-only side questions that do not interrupt the main task

command.description: Ask a read-only side question without interrupting the main task

usage.empty: Usage: /btw <your question>. Run /btw with no question to reopen the last answer.
usage.noHistory: No side question yet in this session.

answer.truncated: The answer was cut off; ask again to retry.
answer.panelOnly: Side question answered; the full answer is in the side-question panel.

error.forkUnavailable: Side questions are unavailable right now (the subagent runtime is not loaded).
error.forkFailed: The side question could not start. Try again, or ask in the main conversation.
error.emptyAnswer: The model returned no answer. Try rephrasing, or ask in the main conversation.
error.timeout: The side question timed out before it answered.
error.tooLong: That question is too long ({length} characters, limit {max}).

cost.warn: This session's context is ~{pressure} tokens; a side question forks the whole session, and earlier runs actually used 0.75–1.2× that (~{low}–{high} tokens). If the cache expired, expect that order of magnitude.

threadFull: This side-question thread is full ({max} turns). Start a new one.
